entry.title: I Finally Decided to Migrate My Blog from Hexo to Hugo
entry.summary:
I used Hexo for many years. At first it was simple, did what I needed, and its theme was easy to customize. Over the years, though, I kept adding features, tweaking styles, and filling in plugins and scripts to suit my habits. I had customized far too much.

Looking back, the site still ran, but it had become increasingly fragile. The last time I upgraded to version 6.3, all my customizations kept me busy for ages. This migration isn’t because Hexo is bad. I’ve simply changed too much, and the cost of maintaining those customizations has started to outweigh the convenience they bring.

entry.title: Life is full of dreams
entry.summary:
Flowers bloom and wither, and even the most brilliant starlight will one day fade away. The Earth, the Sun, and even the entire universe will one day face their end. Compared with all of this, a human life is no more than a brief moment. In that fleeting moment, we smile, weep, struggle, hurt, rejoice, grieve, love someone, hate someone. Everything is but a chance encounter in that instant, and no one can escape the eternal sleep that awaits us all.

Rather than choosing tears, pain, sorrow, and hatred, I would rather choose smiles, struggle, joy, and love. Everything we encounter in this brief moment, whether good or bad, will not change because of how we feel about it. So I choose to face it with joy and to savor this fleeting moment to the fullest. And when you begin to truly enjoy it, you will discover that somehow, all the things that once seemed bad have changed.

Imagine you’re a wealthy individual, sitting in a luxurious office, a glass of aged whiskey in hand, overlooking the city lights. You’ve made money from your money, your wealth snowballing. Of course, you don’t want ordinary people to climb to your level and share in your pie.

So, you meticulously design consumer traps, like levels in a game, luring the poor into their trap. Each level holds a “candy” that glitters and is irresistibly sweet: 10,000 yuan for the latest iPhone, its screen gleaming like a diamond; 100,000 yuan for a used luxury car, its roaring engine making your heart race; 500,000 yuan for the down payment on a small apartment, making you feel like you’ve “finally got a home”; 1 million yuan for a lavish overseas trip, shared on social media for everyone to like…
